description: This file declares the XCast class, which is part of a plugin system within the WPEFramework. It defines the class interface, including methods for initialization, deinitialization, handling various application requests related to casting, and internal state management variables. It also includes references to external modules and classes for plugin and JSONRPC support.

classes.name: XCast
classes.description: A plugin class for handling casting-related functionalities and JSONRPC communication within the WPEFramework. It inherits from AbstractPlugin and RtNotifier, includes methods for plugin lifecycle management, application control, and internal state handling, and manages casting enablement and power states.
